    Revolutionizing Drywall Finishing

    Canvas, the world’s first robotic drywall finishing company, provides a new class of robotic tool for the drywall finishing trade. Delivering both Level 4 and Level 5 finishes, our machines improve the quality, speed, and affordability of drywall finishing while increasing the safety to workers.

    The Canvas Advantage

    Trailblazing Technology for Interior Trades
    First company globally to use the precision of robotics to develop a drywall machine
    Accelerate Schedules, Boost Productivity
    Improve worker productivity by automating repetitive tasks and reducing skill dependent quality variations
    Drive Competitive Advantage
    Stay ahead of the rising skilled labor shortage by leveraging advanced robotic machinery
    Improve the Lives of Our Workforce
    Enhance worker well-being by reducing physical strain, reducing high-height work and minimizing exposure to hazardous materials
